author: a. n. kent
title: North Florida baseball wins walk-off against FGCU in series opener - Duval Times
text:
North Florida Baseball earned a walk-off win over Florida Gulf Coast University, 5-4, at Harmon Stadium on March 20 in the first game of their series.
The game was marked by a late comeback from North Florida after FGCU scored two runs each in the sixth and seventh innings. North Florida responded with five unanswered runs across its final two at-bats to secure the victory.
Sophomore utility player Seth Alford played a key role, hitting a three-run home run in the bottom of the eighth inning to bring North Florida within one run. In the ninth inning, Alford was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded, tying the game at four. Redshirt sophomore outfielder Carter White then drew a bases-loaded walk to complete the walk-off win for North Florida.
Pitcher Dakota Stone recorded the win for North Florida, improving his record to 4-2 after pitching six innings and allowing two earned runs while striking out nine batters. For FGCU, Evan Dempsey took the loss despite contributing both offensively and on the mound with three hits and three runs batted in.
North Florida finished with five runs on four hits and no errors, while FGCU had four runs on ten hits without errors. The teams will meet again for Game 2 of their series at Harmon Stadium on Saturday, March 21 at 3:05 p.m.
